_source: Frozen copy harness_20261006_1200.db of harness/data/harness.db (SQLite online backup API, 2026-10-06 12:00:05 CDT), knowledge table, read through a mode=ro connection; no knowledge row was created after 2026-10-05 20:10 CDT, so status, composition, importance and confidence equal the 2026-10-05 20:30 values; access counts changed (9 entries were returned between 20:30 and 12:00, none after 12:00). composition: SELECT source_type, kind, count(*) FROM knowledge WHERE status='active' GROUP BY 1,2. importance: SELECT source_type, importance, count(*) ... status='active'. returned: SELECT source_type, count(*), sum(access_count>0), sum(access_count) FROM knowledge WHERE status='active' GROUP BY 1 (access_count counts every search result and every brief 'relevant' result (get does not count), including ctl calls coding agents made while testing).
